notes.title: Add New Endings and Partial Controller Support Updates!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1645140/Apple_Bang/][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1744562371688364050/F67B2A907EA1F502D269D05B51454A4F88A41F26/[/img][/url]

Hello, I'm Sundoe.
With this update, 3 endings including strawberry endings have been added, 
so you can see a total of 5 endings!
Also, 4 new steam achievements have been added.
Also, I updated the Xbox controller to make it available, but it is not perfect 
(partly a keyboard is required).
There was no adjustment to the difficulty of the game.
If you have any questions about updates or have any bugs, 
please leave a message on Steam Community or Please email me at ssundou11@gmail.com!

Thank you.

notes.title: Update Checkpoint!
notes.notes:
From now on, you can create a single-use portal by using a magical portal generation device. 
Maid's apple errand is expected to be easier! 
Thank you.

notes.title: I uploaded the developer walkthrough video!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=fHDxTlfK208;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


It may contain a lot of spoilers, so please be careful when you watch it.

notes.title: I am thinking of add check point or save point
notes.notes:
Many people are having a hard time in the beginning.
In fact, I didn't put in a save system because I was afraid the game would be too easy, but I thought I'd put in a checkpoint or save system after watching the play from many users.
I'll make sure to implement it as soon as possible.

notes.title: I adjusted the difficulty of the beginning!
notes.notes:
There was an opinion that the trap at the beginning was not intuitive, so I adjusted the difficulty level. Please continue to give us your opinion. 
Thank you!
